description: This file defines the class SugarWidgetFieldcurrency_id, a custom widget for handling currency fields within the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods for retrieving currency lists, displaying currency symbols with ISO codes, and customizing query sorting based on currency data.

classes.name: SugarWidgetFieldcurrency_id
classes.description: A specialized widget class extending SugarWidgetFieldEnum to manage and display currency fields with custom behavior for SuiteCRM.

methods.name: getCurrenciesList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of currency beans, including the default system currency, optionally refreshing the cache.

methods.name: displayListPlain
methods.description: Overrides default display to show the currency symbol and ISO code, caching results for efficiency.

methods.name: queryOrderBy
methods.description: Customizes the ORDER BY clause in queries to sort currency fields properly, considering currencies that may not be stored in app list strings.
